name: Iraq (1921–1924)
description: Three horizontal stripes of black, white and green with a red trapezium at the hoist bearing two white seven-pointed stars, one above the other.
history: First flag of the Kingdom of Iraq under the British mandate, adopted on 23 August 1921 when Faisal I was crowned: the Arab Revolt colours with a red trapezium, which soon replaced the original triangle, and two seven-pointed stars for the Tigris and the Euphrates. It was replaced on 10 July 1924 by a version with a longer trapezium and the stars side by side, and the same design was revived for the Arab Federation of Iraq and Jordan in 1958.
